albums.blurb: I moved into a flat in the city where an old, abandoned bonsai tree stood in the corner of the living room. I couldn't revive it, so I brought it back to life as a lamp instead. I tried to stay true to its original form — shades that imitate a standing tree, and only natural materials, wood and wool yarn.

We followed the old trade routes from east to west, course by course, along with the stories that travelled the same roads as the spices. Special thanks to the [Storytellers Club Zurich](https://zurichstorytellers.ch) for taking part and bringing the stories of the Silk Road to life.
An evening about what sits under our feet — the soil, the things that grow in it, and how much of what we eat starts down there.
This one was organised entirely by colour, with each part of the night built around a different one.
Korean temple cooking — the quiet, vegetable-led food that Buddhist monastics have been making for centuries, and the ideas behind why it's cooked that way.
